coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of the 9 ground-truth variable items (22%): target properties (p-logP, QED, binding affinity) and structural diversity, including long-carbon-chain occurrence. Baseline and feedback comparisons provide only a partial match to the required model configurations.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the fixed MOLGEN pipeline scripts and DeepSpeed setup. Replaces ESR1/ACAA1 with EGFR/GSK-3β and does not vary synthetic versus natural-product dataset domains. Substitutes generic LLM/RL feedback groups for the specified pretrained, chemical-feedback-finetuned, and baseline configurations. Reports Top-10/Top-100 rather than Top-3 scores and omits the target-specific binding-affinity improvements of approximately 96.7% and 70.4%.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no conclusion about MOLGEN's high p-logP scores, maintained or improved QED, reduced KD values for ESR1 and ACAA1, mitigation of molecular hallucinations, or maintained molecular diversity.
